# baseline: closure density (800-window triadic closures) across whole log vs the 20507-24038 stretch
def closures_in(lo,hi):
    ev=[e for e in events if lo<=e[2]<=hi]
    et=defaultdict(list)
    for u,v,t in ev: et[frozenset((u,v))].append(t)
    res=[]
    nb=defaultdict(dict)
    for pp,ts in et.items():
        if len(pp)!=2: continue
        a,b=tuple(pp)
        nb[a][b]=sorted(ts); nb[b][a]=sorted(ts)
    for u,v,t in ev:
        for c in set(nb[u])&set(nb[v]):
            if c in (u,v): continue
            ta=[x for x in nb[u][c] if x<t]; tb=[x for x in nb[v][c] if x<t]
            if ta and tb:
                base=max(max(ta),max(tb))
                if base<=t<=base+800: res.append((t,u,v,c)); break
    return res
for lo,hi in [(0,18400),(18400,35952),(35952,60000),(60000,100000)]:
